product.title: New Orleans in a Day - Includes 75 Minute Riverboat Cruise

description.text: Experience New Orleans in one extended sightseeing outing with a guided French Quarter walk, free time for lunch at the French Market, a 75-minute Mississippi River cruise aboard the Riverboat CITY of NEW ORLEANS, and a narrated city highlights bus tour. The route begins at Cafe Beignet in the JAX Brewery Building and combines walking, coach, and riverboat perspectives on the French Quarter, Jackson Square, the Garden District, City Park, the National WWII Museum, Audubon Aquarium, and the downtown riverfront.

highlights: Walk through the historic French Quarter with a local guide.
Use free time for lunch at the French Market.
Cruise the Mississippi River for 75 minutes aboard the Riverboat CITY of NEW ORLEANS.
Travel by narrated coach past New Orleans landmarks including the Garden District, City Park, the National WWII Museum, and Audubon Aquarium.

start.description: Cafe Beignet in the JAX Brewery Building, 600 Decatur Street, New Orleans, LA 70130.

end.description: This activity returns to the Cafe Beignet meeting point at 600 Decatur Street.

itineraryItems.title: Cafe Beignet departure
itineraryItems.description: Meet outside Cafe Beignet in the JAX Brewery Building on Decatur Street for check-in and the start of the day.

itineraryItems.title: French Quarter walking tour
itineraryItems.description: Walk through the historic French Quarter with guide-led context on New Orleans culture, architecture, and early city history.

itineraryItems.title: Jackson Square
itineraryItems.description: Pass Jackson Square while moving through the French Quarter portion of the sightseeing route.

itineraryItems.title: French Market lunch break
itineraryItems.description: Pause at the French Market for independent lunch time before continuing the combined sightseeing experience.

itineraryItems.title: Riverboat CITY of NEW ORLEANS cruise
itineraryItems.description: Board the Riverboat CITY of NEW ORLEANS for a 75-minute Mississippi River sightseeing cruise with captain narration.

itineraryItems.title: New Orleans city highlights bus tour
itineraryItems.description: Continue by narrated coach through city highlight areas including the Garden District, St. Charles Avenue, and above-ground cemetery scenery.

itineraryItems.title: Audubon Aquarium
itineraryItems.description: Pass Audubon Aquarium along the downtown riverfront during the city highlights sequence.

itineraryItems.title: City Park
itineraryItems.description: Pass New Orleans City Park as the coach route introduces broader city neighborhoods beyond the French Quarter.

itineraryItems.title: Garden District
itineraryItems.description: Travel through the Garden District for views of historic homes and neighborhood streets from the coach route.

itineraryItems.title: The National WWII Museum
itineraryItems.description: Pass the National WWII Museum during the narrated city highlights portion of the tour.

inclusions: Lunch break at the French Market
75-minute Riverboat CITY of NEW ORLEANS cruise
additionalInfo: Pickup is offered on selected bookings.
Wheelchair accessible with advance arrangements for accessible bus needs.
Strollers and service animals are allowed.

faqs.question: Where does New Orleans in a Day meet?
faqs.answer: The tour meets outside Cafe Beignet in the JAX Brewery Building at 600 Decatur Street in New Orleans.

faqs.question: How long is the combined New Orleans sightseeing experience?
faqs.answer: The experience is listed at about 6 hours and 45 minutes and returns to the meeting point.
